company.name: OpenX
company.shortDescription: OpenX is a supply-side platform for audience, data, and identity targeting, boosting reach and revenue with top tech and service.
company.description: OpenX is a supply-side platform for audience, data, and identity targeting, boosting reach and revenue with top tech and services. The company’s leading technology aggregates, curates, and values consumer interest in real time on one of the world’s largest and highest quality ad exchanges to ensure marketers reach exactly the audience they want. OpenX serves more than 30,000 of the world’s most recognized brands, more than 1,200 websites, and more than 2,000 premium mobile apps.
